metadata.title: भील प्रदेश आंदोलन कैसे तैयार हुआ | भंवरलाल परमार इंटरव्यू | Interview Bhanwar Lal Parmar
metadata.description: Bhanwar Lal Parmar, a noted tribal leader from Rajasthan, is often described as the backroom strategist and ideological force behind the Bhil Pradesh Movement and the Bharat Adivasi Party. In this rare and exclusive interview with Shyam Sunder, Parmar opens up about the vision behind Bhil Pradesh, the political awakening among tribals, and the importance of preserving and recognising tribal religion and identity. A powerful voice from the grassroots, Parmar shares his insights on the current challenges and future of the tribal movement in India.
